top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise as Fed Hikes to Fight Inflation: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks joined bonds higher as the Federal Reserve lifted interest rates for the first time since 2023 to fight persistently high inflation, boosting its credibility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Fed approves interest rate hike, signals one more to come this year
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike in more than three years and indicated another to come.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan's Michele on Bonds: 'The Dominoes Are Starting to Fall'
top_signals.summary: Bob Michele, JPMorgan Asset Management's global head of fixed income, says the bond market has reached a point of "maximum pain" on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: ‘Go time’: SEC, CFTC prepare to push crypto rules as Clarity Act stalls in Senate
top_signals.summary: CFTC Chair Mike Selig said his agency is "locked in and ready to ship its rules for the new frontier of finance."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Zillow Loses Antitrust Battle Over Chicago Area Listing Feed
top_signals.summary: Zillow Group Inc. lost its bid to force Illinois’ largest provider of real estate listings to provide access to its data about homes for sale.
